faces.name: Gor Muldrak, Amphinologist
faces.oracleText:

At the beginning of your end step, each player who controls the fewest creatures creates a 4/3 blue Salamander Warrior creature token.

Vigilance

faces.name: Gorma, the Gullet
faces.oracleText:
Lifelink
Whenever another creature you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Gorma.
Nontoken creatures you control enter with an additional +1/+1 counter on them for each creature that died under your control this turn.
